```yaml
name: Remove Experimental Decorators
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  remove-experimental-decorators:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run experimental decorator removal script
        id: run_script
        run: |
          TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d-%H-%M-%S")
          BRANCH_NAME="automated/remove-experimental-decorators-$TIMESTAMP"
          
          # Run the script and capture exit code
          python dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py
          SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$?
          
          if [ $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Script failed with exit code: $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE"
            exit $SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE
          fi
          
          # Check if there are any changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create and push branch
        if: env.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b ${{ env.branch_name }}
          git add .
          git commit -m "Remove experimental decorators - automated run"
          git push origin ${{ env.branch_name }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.has_changes == 'true'
        run: |
          PR_BODY_FILE="/tmp/pr_body.txt"
          cat > "$PR_BODY_FILE" << 'EOF'
## Automated Experimental Decorator Removal

This PR was automatically created by removing experimental decorators from the codebase.

### Changes Made

The following experimental decorators were removed:
- Removed @experimental decorator from various functions and classes
- Updated documentation to reflect non-experimental status

### Notes

- This is an automated update that removes experimental decorators.
- Please review the changes carefully before merging.
- The script used for this change is located at `dev/remove_experimental_decorators.py`.

For more information about this process, see the [MLflow documentation](https://mlflow.org/docs/latest/index.html).
EOF

          gh pr create \
            --title "Remove experimental decorators - automated run" \
            --body-file "$PR_BODY_FILE" \
            --head ${{ env.branch_name }} \
            --base main \
            --label "automated"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
```
